about: measure contests of 2022 in Arizona, in the layout of plan/PLAN.md section 3 with the fields data/README.md adds (D3). Built by pipeline/local_medsl.py from pipeline/intake/medsl_precinct.py's cache.

medsl.name: MIT Election Data and Science Lab, Precinct-Level Returns 2022 by Individual State, Harvard Dataverse doi:10.7910/DVN/UYQIEP, version 5.0
medsl.note: precinct returns compiled by MEDSL from each state's official sources (named per state in its README); added up to the contest by pipeline/intake/medsl_precinct.py, files 2022-az-local-precinct-general.csv

model.name: the model's own forecast, method D3-v1.1
model.note: each year forecast from a fit on earlier years only; no polls are used

nara.name: National Archives, Electoral College Results (the sitting president's party)
nara.licence: US federal public record; no licence printed

klarner.name: Carl Klarner, State Legislative Election Returns, 1967-2022, Harvard Dataverse doi:10.7910/DVN/FJOGJB, v1.0, released 2024-06-12T21:56:14Z (the races route (a) is fitted on)

census_places.name: U.S. Census Bureau, 2020 Census: national_place_by_county2020.txt (each place once for each county it lies in; codes2020 reference files)
census_places.licence: a work of the U.S. Government (17 U.S.C. 105); no licence printed

census_cousub.name: U.S. Census Bureau, 2020 Census: national_cousub2020.txt (each county subdivision with its county; codes2020 reference files), read only to hold a title whose name is also a town's or township's
census_cousub.licence: a work of the U.S. Government (17 U.S.C. 105); no licence printed
